The structure of Mg6Mn2Sn2O16 (Mg3MnSnO8) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 26 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Corner-sharing is observed between Mg tetrahedra, Mg tetrahedra and Mn octahedra, and Mg tetrahedra and Sn tetrahedra, forming a three-dimensional periodic connectivity network.
